_note: Edit freely: the app reads this from GET /api/v1/plans. 'available': false shows a plan as 'Coming soon' (no payments yet). Prices are USD per month. Cost per reel is roughly $0.013 on Groq (about $0.05 if it falls back to Grok) (up to ~$0.06 on the fallback model). App-store fees take 15-30% and every free user can cost up to ~$0.60 a month, so Plus and Pro are priced to leave room for both.
